opennyai_summary.decision:
Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has moved this Court for gr privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Pachamba P. S. Case No. 159 of 2022, for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 379, 354, 498A, 504, 506/34 of I.P.C.
Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2, under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks, failing which, this application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
Considering all the facts and circumstances, I am inclined to grant the privilege of provisional anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the above-named applicant is directed to surrender in the court below and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the Court below shall enlarge the above named applicant, on provisional bail for two months from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Giridih in connection with Pachamba P. S. Case No. 159 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
Further, the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below, which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the Court.
Put up this case on 31.07.2023.
